discovery: Controlled/living radical polymerization (atom transfer radical polymerization and RAFT), enabling precise synthesis of well-defined polymers and functional macromolecular materials
rationale: Recent Chemistry prizes went to bio-oriented and framework-materials topics (protein design in 2024, MOFs in 2025), so a return to synthetic polymer and materials chemistry fits the committee's rotation. ATRP and RAFT changed how polymers are made in academia and industry. The method is highly cited and has been recognized with the Wolf Prize and other major awards, and its pioneers are long-standing perennial favorites.
